facts.text: Maria expressed willingness to provide support to John whenever he needs it.

evidence.quote: No worries, John. Whenever you need help, just let me know.

facts.text: John acknowledged Maria's support and expressed gratitude for her being there for him.

evidence.quote: Your support really means a lot, Maria. Thanks for always being there for me.

facts.text: Maria reaffirmed her commitment to being there for John and called him a great friend.

evidence.quote: Of course, John. You're a great friend to me. I'll always be there for you.

facts.text: John expressed appreciation for their friendship and mentioned their shared goal.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Maria. Friendship means a lot to me. I'm glad we have each other's backs and can work towards a shared goal.
